<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 11"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Evil-Reflecting Shield](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3161)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Abjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=2" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web](/Sources.aspx?ID=225) pg. 75

**Price** 1,250 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A bright, octagonal frame surrounds this circular mithral shield, which itself is polished to a mirrorlike sheen that reflects clear and true. While you have this standard-grade [mithral shield](/Equipment.aspx?ID=314) (Hardness 5, HP 20, BT 10) raised, you gain its circumstance bonus to saving throws against spells with the [evil](/Traits.aspx?ID=64) or [negative](/Traits.aspx?ID=118) trait. 

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> command ([fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=612)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You attempt a saving throw against an effect with the [evil](/Traits.aspx?ID=64) or [negative](/Traits.aspx?ID=118) traits;  **Effect** Your saving throw result is considered one degree better than the actual result. If this effect turns a success into a critical success, you can reflect some of the effect's power as a wave of magical backlash back to the source of the triggering effect, as long as the source is within 30 feet. When you do so, the target must succeed at a DC 28 Fortitude save or become [stunned](/Conditions.aspx?ID=93) 1.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
